Bulletin No: 01 LRA/26/02/18/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Heavy Rain
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 01.00 p.m. on 18 February 2026 valid for the period until 01.00 p.m. 19 February 2026
For Uva province and Polonnaruwa, Batticaloa, Ampara, Matale and Nuwara-
Eliya districts
PLEASE BE AWARE!
Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at
some places in Uva province and in
Polonnaruwa, Batticaloa, Ampara, Matale
and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Therefore, general public is advised to
take adequate precautions to minimize
damages caused by heavy rain, strong
winds and lightning during
thundershowers.
Color: -Red Color: -Amber Color: -Green
